title: Mutation of active site glutamate in serine hydroxymethyltransferase allows trapping a reactive intermediate: a combined neutron and X-ray crystallography study
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,22600-22609
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA01814A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Victoria N. Drago, Robert S. Phillips, Andrey Kovalevsky
Neutron crystallography visualized hydrogen atoms and protonation states in TthSHMT E53Q enzyme. The mutation permitted trapping an intermediate with L-Ser and THF substrates that demonstrates structural preorganization for the next catalytic step.
